verdict.rationale: Mesh documents some configurable compliance logic: an editable risk-score equation (docs-2), multiple screening configurations that can be chosen per customer (docs-5), and screening-list selection set up with compliance teams. However, nothing shows these are edited in a no-code builder, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized at all. missing for 10: evidence of a no-code/UI workflow editor, conditional step logic, risk-based routing rules, country-specific requirement configuration, template changes without an engineering deploy, independent corroboration.
